note: Flagged items do not block the merge. Each one links to the source checked, or to the repository file for governance items.

rows.item: PR #3 (arena/23927d63-nba2) injury file: 5 of 10 records have a wrong team, game, time or injury reason against the official 11/13 5:15 PM PDF (Haliburton, Butler III, Simmons, Jackson Jr., Porzingis).
rows.why: Wrong team/game attachment would move a player's status to the wrong game.
rows.action: Correct from the official PDF before merging, or drop the file.

rows.item: PR #3 picks file: all 7 game IDs are invented ('GAME-20261113-00x'); MEM@NOP time is 8:30 (official 8:00 PM ET); CLE@MIA is 'TBD' (official 8:00 PM ET); NYK@IND and POR@SAC are missing; Sat-Mon games are absent.
rows.why: Invented IDs cannot be reconciled with the league schedule.
rows.action: Replace with official game IDs from the schedule (data/verified/schedule_2026-11-13_to_16.json).

rows.item: PR #3 strategies file: 8 correlation or numeric claims (r ≈ 0.82, 0.65, 0.58, 0.71, -0.48; ~1.5 possessions) have no official source. Five cite non-official sites. The cited NBA.com/Stats FAQ does not contain the values.
rows.why: Presenting unsourced correlations as findings violates the no-inference rule.
rows.action: Remove the numbers or mark them unverified and blank.

rows.item: NBA.com/Stats FAQ: 'Our stats are not available for download for either academic or personal use.' Any data pipeline built on NBA.com stats needs a rights review first.
rows.why: Scraping or downloading for personal analysis may conflict with the site's stated terms.
rows.action: Obtain written permission or use a licensed feed; record the decision.

rows.item: The 2024-25 injury-report URL resolves to the 2026-27 page (the fetch returned the final URL). Older boards still cite the 2024-25 URL.
rows.why: Links to a redirected page can go stale and show the wrong season.
rows.status: Resolved in links; confirm old references

rows.item: Injury PDF text extraction: 40 rows have no matchup or team printed (sorted to 'unattributed'); one team cell is split across chunks (Raynaud, Maxime; reconstructed as Sacramento Kings); some words are joined in the text (e.g. 'AnkleSprain').
rows.why: Attribution of 40 rows to a game or team is unverified.
rows.action: Re-read the PDF visually or from the official source before using these rows.

rows.item: No rows are printed for Milwaukee (MIL@ORL) or New York (NYK@IND) in the extracted 11/13 5:15 PM report. Unknown whether a team with no entries means no injuries or a missing submission.
rows.why: Absence of rows could be read as 'healthy'.
rows.action: Confirm against the official reporting rules and the PDF; do not treat absence as healthy.

rows.item: Rotation-minute and production impact of injuries: no official minutes baseline was retrieved, so the minutes column is blank for every row.
rows.why: The brief asks for minutes impact; no verified basis exists here.
rows.action: Source official minutes/box-score history (permitted use) and model conditional minutes with intervals.

rows.item: Only the 11/13 5:15 PM report was used. Reports for 11/14 onward are not in the snapshot. Several 11/14 teams show 'NOT YET SUBMITTED' (DEN@NOP both teams, BKN@MEM MEM, CHI@MIN CHI).
rows.action: Re-run the report capture on each game day; keep timestamped snapshots.

rows.item: No odds, lines, or historical results are in the repository, so 0 picks were issued. The NBA schedule page has a 'Hide Odds' control; the source and licence of any odds it shows were not identified and were not used.
rows.why: Edge and CLV cannot be measured without timestamped prices from a permitted source.
rows.action: Identify a licensed price source; record quote time, odds and availability.

rows.item: Ksa (Kansspelautoriteit): before gambling online or offline, check whether the provider holds a licence; the Kansspelwijzer lists providers allowed to offer games of chance in NL. A leaderboard with rewards could be a gambling activity depending on design (entry fee, prize, chance element). Not a legal opinion.
rows.why: Operating a rewarded competition or taking wagers may need a licence or legal review.
rows.action: Obtain qualified Dutch legal advice before any reward, entry-fee or wagering feature is built.

rows.item: Brief's branch naming (session-<id>/<task>) conflicts with the assigned naming (arena/<session>-nba2). The brief's placeholder 'session-&amp;lt;id&amp;gt;' is malformed.
rows.why: Parallel sessions may not find each other's work.
rows.action: Confirm the naming convention; this session used arena/71f94203-nba2.

rows.item: Four sessions claimed overlapping scope (strategies, dashboard, verification, integration). Merged to main: dashboard only (PRs #1, #2). Open: PR #3. No integration yet.
rows.why: Duplicated and conflicting pages and data.
rows.action: Pick one owner for each file in the integration step; reconcile PR #3 with the audit above.
